recommendations.rationale: Your REST API work with FastAPI and React front‑ends will benefit from GraphQL’s flexible data fetching, reducing over‑fetching in UI components you already build.
Migrating your monolith to microservices creates a need for reliable event streaming, and Kafka is the industry standard for that pattern you’re already implementing.
You already deploy on AWS and manage containers with Kubernetes; Terraform will let you codify that infrastructure as reusable modules, streamlining future deployments.
Running high‑traffic microservices requires real‑time metrics; Prometheus and Grafana integrate with Kubernetes to give you the visibility you need for scaling decisions.
You have strong React experience; Next.js adds server‑side rendering and static site generation, boosting performance for the web apps you deliver.

ai_displacement_exposure.explanation: This role contains a mix of routine tasks and tasks requiring human judgment. AI will augment rather than replace most of the work. AI‑powered code assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) now generate boilerplate for React components and CI/CD configs, while automated monitoring agents ingest logs into Grafana dashboards, letting developers focus on core logic rather than repetitive setup.
